name: The majority voted against [amendments](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2024-11-26.271.1) introduced by Queensland Senator [Penny Allman-Payne](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/queensland/penny_allman-payne) (Greens), which means it failed. Senator Allman-Payne [explained that](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2024-11-26.271.1): > *Given that the government won't support increasing the Commonwealth contribution to 25 per cent, this amendment seeks to increase the contribution of the federal government to our public schools to 22½ per cent.* ### Amendment text > *(1) Schedule 1, item 3, page 4 (line 11), omit "20 per cent", substitute "22.5 per cent".* > > *(2) Schedule 1, item 7, page 5 (line 19), omit "20%", substitute "22.5%".*
